 Party fails to get Amritpal’s interim bail amended; grandma’s cremation deferred 
 Trending Kolkata Suicide Kolkata Murder Kangana Ranaut Agra Murder Delhi AQI Kottayam Murder Kolkata Suicide Kolkata Murder Kangana Ranaut Agra Murder Delhi AQI Kottayam Murder Kolkata Suicide Kolkata Murder Kangana Ranaut Agra Murder Delhi AQI Kottayam Murder Party fails to get Amritpal’s interim bail amended; grandma’s cremation deferred 
 Yudhvir Rana / Nov 15, 2026, 00:10 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Amritpal Singh Amritsar : Efforts by Akali Dal Waris Punjab De to get a court order on a day’s interim bail to jailed Khadoor Sahib MP Amritpal Singh amended failed on Saturday as the party’s legal team could not secure a hearing before either the duty magistrate or the sessions judge. A local court had granted Amritpal bail on Saturday to attend the cremation of his grandmother. When the party realised that he wouldn’t be able to arrive in his native village Jallupur Khera (an hour’s drive from Amritsar) in time from Dibrugarh jail, they sought to have the court order amended for a later date. Party chief spokesperson Shamsher Singh Padhri said the party’s legal team first approached the duty magistrate’s court but found it closed as it was the second Saturday. They then went to the magistrate’s residence, where another matter was being heard, and they were advised to return to the court. However, when they returned, the duty magistrate was unavailable. The team approached another duty magistrate but was not granted a hearing. They also visited the sessions judge’s residence but were informed that the judge was unavailable, Padhri said.  “Consequently, the Friday order granting Amritpal one-day interim bail could not be amended. We will file a fresh application seeking an amendment on Monday,” he said. Amritpal’s grandmother Charan Kaur died on Nov 8 but the family has held back the cremation until Amritpal arrives. He has been lodged in Dibrugarh jail since April 23, 2023. The family had sought four days’ interim bail, from Nov 14 to 17, to enable him to attend the cremation and other religious ceremonies, but the court granted only one day. Padhri said Amritpal’s uncle, Harjeet Singh, who is lodged in Bathinda jail and was granted three days’ interim bail, reached Jallupur Khera and spent three to four hours with the family. Another relative, Sukhmanpreet Singh, who was granted two days’ interim bail and is lodged in Amritsar jail, was yet to be released.
